## Package-budget workflow review repair

User-directed follow-up to criteria `4187998807` and `4187998815`. Exact candidate: `d012d8630279fd8df228bc7b6cfb10c0d8936e9c`, preserving contributor parent `3c25b74f94e6d1576f8d133704cd55d462198733`. One real-hook/DCO commit; publication is an ordinary non-force branch push, not history rewriting.

### Source-bound internal walkthrough

| Handoff state | Before repair | Frozen repaired candidate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enter `pui-package-budget` with a candidate-change lacking its digest | Could enter with an unbound candidate | Reject before admission, for any source and both v1/v2 |
| Enter with repeated v2 candidate-change materials and only some digests | An incomplete multi-candidate binding could survive | Require a digest on **every** candidate-change |
| Constrained terminal stop from this leaf, no substantive note | Could omit blocker / evidence-refresh explanation | Require **at least one nonblank note** |
| Other leaves / optional-digest artifacts / received handoff | Existing generic and binding semantics | Unchanged; unrelated route and unchanged-candidate controls remain enforced |

The repair is confined to `scripts/agent-operations/skill-registry.mjs`, three existing behavioral test files and the existing budget skill handoff guidance. Structural guards do not authenticate opaque evidence contents or the truth of prose.

Native **synthetic v1/v2 handoffs through the real validator** reproduced both governed failures before source edits and passed against the frozen candidate. No actual numerical-budget transaction or live collaboration operation was used as smoke input.

- Final focused evidence: **19/19 passed**. The initial 18/19 run is retained: one new unrelated-route control accidentally used a recursive source. Only that test control was corrected to the registered `pui-regression` → `pui-validate` route; no numeric or handoff guard was weakened.
- Complete AgentOps validation: **733/733 passed**, Node24.21.0, no failures/skips/cancellations/todos.
- Agent-doc check passed: projection is renderable; disposable local projection was absent as expected, not claimed as regenerated.
- Independent read-only **local frozen-candidate** review: correct, no findings. It inspected retained proof without rerunning validation; this is not GitHub APPROVED, a sealed new-head review, or trusted CI.
- Executed smoke source was archived before removing only the owned throwaway script.

No numerical budget, measured package size, handoff schema, generic optional-digest rule, received-handoff deep-equality/binding retention or unrelated routing was changed. Exact-head trusted CI, independent platform approval and repository rules remain required before integration. No self-approval, merge, CI rerun or settings change is claimed.

fullOriginalReviewClauses.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject digestless candidates before entering the budget leaf**

When a structurally valid incoming handoff contains a `candidate-change` without the optional `digest`, `pui-package-budget` can be entered but cannot use its required pre-edit terminal path after discovering stale or otherwise unusable measurements: retaining the candidate fails this assertion, while adding a digest fails the preceding deep-equality check. This affects both v1 and v2 because ordinary handoff validation permits omitted digests, so either require candidate digests when routing into this leaf or permit an unchanged digestless candidate to terminate.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L17-L17](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/45af0397c107e534f1c2ebe889da338fa360a2b1/AGENTS.md#L17-L17)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require a blocker note for constrained terminal handoffs**

When `pui-package-budget` returns its unchanged candidate with `nextSkillId: null`, this branch accepts the handoff even if `notes` is empty—the new v2 integration fixture exercises exactly that case. The leaf contract requires explicit blocker and refresh work in the notes, so the current validator lets the workflow stop without recording why no transaction occurred or what must happen next; require at least one nonempty note for this constrained terminal path.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L17-L17](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/45af0397c107e534f1c2ebe889da338fa360a2b1/AGENTS.md#L17-L17)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject duplicate models in candidate rankings**

When a schema-v2 collaboration receipt is ingested, a caller can replace a lower-ranked candidate's `modelId`/`familyId` with the top candidate's values, recompute the unkeyed receipt ID, and pass this validation because only the candidate count is constrained; the later loop verifies that each entry exists in the bank but never that models are distinct. `buildModelTraceRecord` cannot produce such a ranking because the scorer emits one result per bank model, so require unique candidate model identities in both runtime and schema validation before accepting the receipt as canonical.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L23-L23](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/84cb87e1f094bd53506d2d2419eefdf38f8c3a70/AGENTS.md#L23-L23)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep challenge context inputs outside the checkout**

When `challenge` is invoked with `--context` pointing inside the checkout, this path reads the private session ID and context declarations without the containment check applied to every `score` input. The command succeeds and leaves that private context file available for staging; copying it outside before publication also means the publisher's check of the later supplied path cannot detect the original. Apply the same realpath-based outside-repository check to the challenge context before reading it.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L23-L23](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/84cb87e1f094bd53506d2d2419eefdf38f8c3a70/AGENTS.md#L23-L23)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Verify the scorer before importing executable code**

When the vendored scorer is modified or replaced in a checkout, this static import executes that file before `loadBank()` compares its bytes with `SCORER_DIGEST`. A malicious scorer can therefore read `process.argv`, environment credentials, or private ModelTrace files and perform arbitrary side effects before the checksum error is raised, defeating the claimed integrity and privacy boundary. Load executable scorer code only from the bytes after their digest has been verified, with the verification and evaluation protected against replacement races.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L23-L23](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/84cb87e1f094bd53506d2d2419eefdf38f8c3a70/AGENTS.md#L23-L23)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind collaboration receipts to measurement chronology**

When a schema-v2 collaboration receipt embeds a ModelTrace receipt measured after the claimed mutation, `validateModelTraceReceipt` accepts its structure and this check verifies only the repository, so ingestion treats the later measurement as attribution for the earlier write. This permits retroactive ModelTrace attachment—the existing synthetic receipt path even accepts `verifiedAt` values preceding `modelTrace.measuredAt`—despite the requirement that measurement be current before a write. Require the measurement to precede the receipt's verified mutation time and, where available, bind freshness to the platform object's write timestamp.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L23-L23](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/84cb87e1f094bd53506d2d2419eefdf38f8c3a70/AGENTS.md#L23-L23)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reconcile publications before enforcing receipt freshness**

When an Issue, PR, comment, or body update was already published but the acknowledgement was lost or the command is rerun after the receipt expires, this unconditional `measure()` call fails freshness before `findPublished()` can perform its read-only marker/full-body reconciliation. Supplying a new measurement does not recover the operation because its disclosure changes the expected full body, so an unknown successful write can no longer be resolved through the supported publisher. Fresh evidence beyond the earlier collaboration-validation issue is that this separate publisher path blocks its own idempotent readback; load and validate the historical bound record for reconciliation, then require freshness only immediately before a mutation.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L23-L23](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/84cb87e1f094bd53506d2d2419eefdf38f8c3a70/AGENTS.md#L23-L23)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
